name: pl.gdziezabawa/imprezy
title: GdzieZabawa.pl
description: Events and things to do in every Polish municipality: festivals, fairs, theatre, stand-up, kids.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming local events in Poland listed on GdzieZabawa.pl, for questions like "what to do this weekend in my town", "dożynki, jarmarki or festyny nearby", "free events for kids in Kraków": festivals, dożynki, town days, fairs, picnics, children's events, concerts, theatre, cabaret. Filters: municipality, voivodeship, dates or a `when` shortcut, category, free admission, title phrase. Returns up to 20 events per call (page with offset/next_offset) with date, time, place, admission and event page link, plus the total. Default range: the catalogue window (about the next two months). / Co robić w weekend w gminie: festyny, dożynki, jarmarki, imprezy dla dzieci; gmina, województwo, daty, kategoria, wstęp wolny. All arguments are optional; example call: {"municipality": "Kraków", "when": "this_weekend"} or {"voivodeship": "małopolskie", "category": "festyn", "free_only": true}.

municipality.description: Polish municipality (gmina) or town in nominative case, e.g. "Skawina", "Kraków". If the name exists in several voivodeships, add `voivodeship`. / Gmina lub miasto.

when.description: Date shortcut in Europe/Warsaw; this_weekend = Friday to Sunday of the current week (from today when it is already Friday-Sunday; same rule as KiedyKoncert). Overrides date_from/date_to.

free_only.description: Only events with free admission (wstęp wolny).

query.description: Words from the event title, e.g. "dożynki", "mikołajki", "jarmark". / Fraza z nazwy imprezy.

offset.description: Skip this many matches; use next_offset.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event on GdzieZabawa.pl by its id (slug) or page URL: name, next date and time, place, municipality, admission, description, further dates and the source website. Required: `id` (slug from search_events) or `url`; example call: {"id": "<id from search_events>"}. Call search_events first when you have no id. / Szczegóły jednej imprezy.

url.description: Event page URL exactly as returned by search_events (format https://gdziezabawa.pl/wydarzenie/<id>).

tools.name: municipality_attractions
tools.description: Permanent places for free time in one Polish municipality from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): cinemas, swimming pools, aquaparks, museums, parks, playgrounds, bowling, escape rooms, zoos. Name, kind, address, website and opening hours when known. For "what to do on a rainy day" or "where to go with kids" when no event fits. Required: `municipality`; example call: {"municipality": "Skawina"} (add `voivodeship` when the name repeats). / Stałe atrakcje „na nudę” w gminie: kino, basen, muzeum, park, plac zabaw.

municipality.description: Polish municipality (gmina) or town in nominative case, e.g. "Skawina", "Kraków". If the name exists in several voivodeships, add `voivodeship`. / Gmina lub miasto.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Event categories used by GdzieZabawa.pl (slug, Polish name, number of upcoming events) for the category filter of search_events. / Lista kategorii imprez.
